create_control_module: create a subclass of AbstractControlModule to implement a custom robot control module with enable and disable hooks
use_enforce_enabled_decorator: use the enforce_enabled decorator to restrict a method so it only runs when the control module is enabled
register_wait_thread: register a wait function with _register_wait to run an action in a background thread without blocking
check_is_busy: check if any background action threads are still running by calling the is_busy method
wait_for_threads: wait for all registered background action threads to complete using the wait method with an optional timeout
